text:
sarah-support: FYI received an urgent escal from Acme Analytics — signing latency spiked to ~6s and some audit entries are missing between 2026-03-14T02:00-02:30 UTC. customer says errors started after they applied an on-prem HSM firmware patch.

raj-eng: thanks. do we have correlation IDs or a sample request?

sarah-support: yes, they provided this one: correlation_id=acme-req-9a7f3b, request_id=R-32459. curl shows 502 then 504 intermittently. they also saw a spike in token billing for signing ops.

mike-sre: can you paste the api gateway logs? also pinging @kevin-security for audit retention questions.

sarah-support: gateway snippet (redacted):
```
[2026-03-14T02:11:05Z] R-32459 acme-req-9a7f3b -> 502 HSM_CALL_FAIL
[2026-03-14T02:11:06Z] R-32460 acme-req-9a7f3c -> 504 KV_CACHE_TIMEOUT
[2026-03-14T02:14:12Z] R-32480 acme-req-9a7d0 -> 200 (slow, 5800ms)
```

raj-eng: interesting — 502 HSM_CALL_FAIL + KV_CACHE_TIMEOUT then slow successful sign. could be HSM-side entropy or session starvation. did they attach logs from the HSM appliance?

sarah-support: they attached an onprem agent log:
```
Mar 14 02:10:58 hsm-agent[1234]: WARN low entropy pool size 128 -> blocking sign
Mar 14 02:11:00 hsm-agent[1234]: ERROR open_session failed: ERR_NO_SESSIONS
Mar 14 02:11:06 hsm-agent[1234]: INFO session_recover: queued=12 active=2
Mar 14 02:14:11 hsm-agent[1234]: INFO sign completed duration_ms=5796 key_id=key-az-77
```

mike-sre: that low entropy log is a red flag. cloud HSMs generally manage entropy, but onprem boxes can require RNG reseed after firmware. which vendor?

sarah-support: customer uses an nCipher-like appliance (vendor redacted) with a management AP that pushed a patch at 02:00. they said post-patch the appliance reported "entropy warning" for ~20m.

kevin-security: for compliance: customer is asking why audit events for the 02:00-02:30 window are missing from our retention store. we need to confirm whether events were never emitted by the agent or if they were emitted but dropped by ingestion.

raj-eng: to triage we should: 1) get raw hsm-agent stdout for 01:50-02:40, 2) fetch key-syncer logs for same window, 3) check our ingestion pipeline (kms-proxy -> audit-queue -> retention-store) for dropped messages using correlation_id prefix acme-req-9a7*.

alice-support: i already asked customer for the raw logs and their appliance audit export. they can share by SFTP in 30m. noted on the escalation ticket INC-2026-33. ops-bot created the incident record.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-33 created by sarah-support. Severity: P2. Assignees: raj-eng, mike-sre, kevin-security.

mike-sre: while we wait, quick repro steps for us to try in staging (simulate low entropy):
1) spin up onprem-hsm-sim image (tag: hsm-sim:2026-02)
2) apply simulated firmware patch: `hsm-simctl apply-patch --entropy-deplete`
3) run 100 concurrent sign requests against staging key via `curl -H "X-Correlation-ID: test-low-entropy-$(date +%s)" \
   -d '{"operation":"sign","key":"staging-key-1","payload":"..."}' https://staging.api.redwood/run`
4) tail `hsm-agent` logs and our `kms-proxy` ingestion logs for 502/504 and any "low entropy" warnings.

raj-eng: good. also capture `ss` or `netstat` on the appliance to rule out session socket limits. `hsm-agent status` should show session pool metrics.

kevin-security: regarding audit retention: if the agent never emitted events (appliance-level audit), we need the customer to produce their appliance audit export for regulators. if events were emitted and dropped in our pipeline, we need to elevate to legal/compliance and estimate scope (which orgs, how many events, retention days). I need an initial impact table in the incident doc.

sarah-support: customer reports a billing spike of ~2.4x for signing ops in that hour — likely due to retries. added billing_deets.csv to the incident.

mike-sre: actionable items for this thread:
- raj: run staging repro with hsm-sim and attach logs (by EOD)
- sarah: get raw appliance audit export + SFTP link from customer (in progress)
- kevin: prepare compliance impact matrix template and advise on 90-day retention request
- alice: notify account team and set expectation with Acme (we need audit export for regulators, may take customer time)

raj-eng: starting repro now. quick note: if we confirm RNG reseed is needed, we should document a recommended post-patch checklist for customers (check entropy, ensure forced reseed, monitor session pool).

sarah-support: acme also asked if we can temporarily increase retry backoff on their tenant to reduce billing while they remediate. is that doable?

mike-sre: we can add a tenant-level throttle/backoff policy for signing route. will coordinate with infra to apply for Acme tenant id=acme-123.

kevin-security: tagging legal@ and compliance@ in the incident. we may need to preserve our ingestion logs for 120 days for the potential audit. I'll list retention options in the incident doc.

sarah-support: thanks team. i'll update INC-2026-33 when i get the SFTP link. cc @alice-support for customer comms. :pray:
